settings.heading: Storybook Itineraries
settings.text: At Mr Chocolate’s Travel, we believe every traveller has a story worth telling — and that no two stories are ever the same. That’s why we’ve created Mr Chocolate’s Storybook Itineraries: a collection of journeys inspired by the world’s most beloved tales, iconic people, and favourite shows and movies, designed to spark ideas for your own unique adventure.

settings.text: Explore travel destinations around the world. Where would you like to travel? Contact us for a quote on your desired destination.

settings.heading: Universal Destinations
settings.text: With theme parks across the globe, Universal makes it easier for fans everywhere to experience the excitement of movie magic. This includes Universal Studios Hollywood, Universal Orlando Resort, Universal Studios Japan, Universal Studios Singapore, Universal Beijing Resort, and the upcoming Universal Studios Great Britain.

settings.heading: Disney Destinations
settings.text: These parks located all over the world make it easier for most people to experience the magic of Disney. This includes Disneyland in California, Walt Disney World in Orlando, Hong Kong Disneyland, Shanghai Disneyland, Disneyland Paris, and Tokyo Disneyland.

settings.heading: Legoland Destinations
settings.text: With theme parks around the world, LEGOLAND makes it easy for families everywhere to experience the magic of LEGO. This includes LEGOLAND California, LEGOLAND Florida, LEGOLAND Billund, LEGOLAND Windsor, LEGOLAND Japan, LEGOLAND Malaysia, LEGOLAND Dubai, LEGOLAND Korea, LEGOLAND New York, and LEGOLAND Deutschland.

settings.heading: SeaWorld Destinations
settings.text: With parks spanning the globe, SeaWorld brings the wonder of the ocean to guests everywhere through unforgettable animal encounters, thrilling rides, and immersive experiences. This includes SeaWorld Orlando, SeaWorld San Diego, SeaWorld San Antonio, and the all-new SeaWorld Abu Dhabi—each offering unique ways to connect with marine life and celebrate the beauty of the natural world.
